methodology.priorMove: Detect prior price advance >=30% from the most recent qualifying local swing low to a prior peak.
methodology.retracement: (Prior Peak - Lowest Post-Peak Base Low) / (Prior Peak - Move Start Price) × 100. Current session is excluded.
methodology.consolidationDays: Completed trading sessions strictly between the detected prior peak and the current session. Prior peak day and current/breakout day are excluded.
methodology.volumeContraction: Actual completed post-peak base average volume <=75% of prior move average volume. Prior peak day and current/breakout day are excluded from the base.
methodology.volatilityContraction: Recent average daily range <=75% of prior move average daily range.

breakout.Near Breakout: Current close within 3% below prior peak.
breakout.Base Building: Current close within 10% below prior peak.

methodology.turnoverExpansion: Current traded turnover divided by previous 20-session average turnover.
